sections.text_helper: Section 70.4.2 "MDIOS write flag register (MDIOS_WRFR)" in chapter 70 (Management data input/output (MDIOS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3610.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x004
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:0 WRF[31:0]: write flags for MDIOS registers 0 to 31.
Each bit is set by hardware when the MDIO master performs a write to the corresponding
MDIOS register. An interrupt is generated if WRIE (in MDIOS_CR) is set.
Each bit is cleared by software by writing ‘1’ to the corresponding CWRF bit in the
MDIOS_CWRFR register.
For WRFx:
0: MDIOS register x is not written by the MDIO master.
1: MDIOS register x is written by the MDIO master and the data is available in DIN[15:0] in
the MDIOS_DINRx register.
